description: This file defines the 'BoardSwitcherDialog' React component, which provides a user interface for searching and selecting boards within a team collaboration application. It includes search functionality, keyboard navigation, and routing to specific board pages.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the props for the BoardSwitcherDialog component, specifically an onClose callback.

methods.name: selectBoard
methods.description: Asynchronously navigates to the selected board's page based on teamId and boardId, then calls onClose.

methods.name: searchHandler
methods.description: Performs a search for boards matching the query, returns React nodes for display, and manages refs and IDs for search results.

methods.name: handleEnterKeyPress
methods.description: Handles the Enter key press to select the currently highlighted search result.
